entries.name: BThwani Contextual CI
entries.purpose: Root exact-SHA orchestrator that calculates affected and risk-expanded scope, invokes reusable verification engines, and enforces one fail-closed result.

entries.name: BThwani Policy Verification
entries.purpose: Reusable repository, governance, workflow, security, nomenclature, and infrastructure policy verification engine.

entries.name: BThwani Node Diagnostics
entries.purpose: Reusable affected static diagnostics for boundaries, bindings, accessibility, dependency direction, dead code, duplication, and repository integrity.

entries.name: BThwani Node Verification
entries.purpose: Reusable affected or full typecheck, lint, test, build, contract, and governed capability verification engine.

entries.name: BThwani Backend Verification
entries.purpose: Reusable affected Go backend and isolated PostgreSQL migration, test, vet, and build verification engine.

entries.name: BThwani Runtime Proof
entries.purpose: Reusable runtime startup, bootstrap, readiness, smoke, and teardown proof when the router or explicit request requires runtime evidence.

entries.name: DSH Database Contract
entries.purpose: Verifies the canonical DSH database migrations, schema, seeds, and contract against an isolated PostgreSQL service.

entries.name: BThwani Lockfile Snapshot
entries.purpose: Core read-only lockfile proposal workflow that uploads a frozen-install-compatible candidate artifact without publishing or changing the candidate branch.

entries.name: BThwani Manual Deep Verification
entries.purpose: Core read-only exact-SHA affected and risk-expanded manual verification with optional full runtime proof and a machine-readable decision artifact.

entries.name: Validclean Reconstruction Package Audit
entries.purpose: Read-only verification of the validclean reconstruction package state plus a re-run of the pinned full tracked-file audit against the immutable fbc0139234e2bdb34a8de77d74a6b91297a754b0 baseline. Retirement condition: removed together with tools/validclean-repository-reconstruction once VC-320 records its closure state.
